title: Swole Patrol
description: A paid message from Swole Patrol. A gym, legally.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-smooth
lines.text: [question-en] Want gains? <p:0.2> Swole Patrol is the discount gym with no rules, no staff, and one extremely heavy rock! <p:0.2> Lift the rock. <p:0.2> Become the rock. <p:0.2> Swole Patrol, lift or perish!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: The rock has injured everyone. <p:0> There is no exit, only the rock. <p:0> Membership is inherited by your next of kin. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
